DESCRIPTION.ALURA: Alura is an online education platform recognized in the corporate market, specializing in the development of technical and behavioral skills. It offers learning paths in areas such as technology, design, marketing, business, and soft skills. With practical materials, video lessons, and applicable projects, Alura promotes continuous learning and team development, enabling companies to keep their employees updated and competitive. It is a solution that easily integrates with LMS/LXP platforms to create personalized and impactful learning experiences.
DESCRIPTION.FUTURIZE: Futurize is a company with over 15 years of experience in corporate education, specializing in creating solutions that promote effective learning and engagement in organizations. The company offers innovative and customizable content for LMS, focused on areas such as leadership, diversity, project management, mental health, sales, and more. Its methodologies include microlearning, gamification, and problem-based learning (PBL), providing practical and applicable experiences. Additionally, Futurize stands out for its personalized approach, which recognizes the individuality of learners and adapts content to their specific needs. The company also offers mentorship programs for leadership development and creates content such as e-books, webinars, and interactive materials that easily integrate with LMS/LXP platforms.
DESCRIPTION.VILON_ACADEMY: Vilon Academy is a company specialized in human and organizational development, standing out in the market since 2006. Focused on creating continuous learning environments, Vilon offers customized solutions to meet the needs of companies and teams. Its programs include development paths, workshops, high-impact experiences, mentoring, and coaching, covering topics such as leadership, communication, conflict management, and emotional health. Vilon's methodology values co-creation, creativity, and innovation, providing transformative experiences that promote sustainable growth for individuals and organizations. Additionally, Vilon works in alignment with the culture and objectives of each client, offering relevant and tailored content for diverse audiences.

INFO.DUPLICATE:
• When duplicating this course, all contents will be duplicated to the new one (destination) and any new changes in the origin will not be reflected in the copy.
  • Enrollments will not be affected, the new course will be created without any enrollments.
  • You will be able to continue as the course owner or select a new owner, as long as this owner is a Super admin, Admin, Content creator.
  • Once duplicated, you will not be able to reverse that action.
INFO.SHARE:
• When sharing this course with another workspace, the link with the origin will be maintained and all changes made will be reflected in the workspaces that were shared.
  • Enrollment data will not be shared.
  • You can unshare at any time.
INFO.TRANSFER:
• When transferring, you will no longer have permission to edit the content if you do not have access to the new workspace as Super admin, Admin or Content creator.
  • If you transfer to another owner, you can only edit if you are Super Admin.
  • Once transferred, you will not be able to reverse this action.
